title: On Constructing and Decoding Quantum Triorthogonal Codes
summary: Triorthogonal codes are a basic ingredient in magic-state distillation, as they enable transversal implementation of logical $\mathsf{T}$ gates. As a non-Clifford operation, the $\mathsf{T}$ gate enables universal fault-tolerant quantum computation when combined with Clifford operations. We derive an existence criterion for even-weight triorthogonal generator matrices with a target dual minimum distance.
